regression_verified: All 118 prior backend tests still pass (login all roles, SOAP notes, forms + signatures + upload/download, invoices, admin edit user, brute-force lockout, patients, appointments, messages, stats)
Receptionist form creation, patient public submit flow (form -> received status), and responses view all functional
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DEFAULT_SETTINGS is returned from get_settings_doc when db has no doc — but each field returned then may be missing 'key' after $set upsert; verified {_id,key} projected out. Fine.

SettingsInput.clinic_name is required (good); other fields Optional with '' default. Payload always writes full doc (model_dump) — no partial patch semantics; consider PATCH if partial updates needed later.
Logo size check (900000 chars ~= 650KB base64) is applied only on PUT. Consider also bounding on total settings doc size or storing binary in GridFS if larger logos ever needed.
Frontend Letterhead.js gracefully hides missing fields; good defensive rendering.
server.py now at 927 lines — still growing; recommend splitting notes/forms/invoices/settings into routers soon.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all letterhead UI + integration + authz flows verified)
